'''Wookiee luau''' was a type of food that gave off a strong smell when cooked. The dish was related to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]<ref name="Shadows" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and could be found on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Shadows" /> around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] smelled Wookiee luau cooking in the open [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] while he was in [[Ploughtekal Market]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wookiee luau first appeared as a smell in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Smell only}}
